context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 1 (Bíblia insertBefore) and Bug 2 (Aula iframe video) are both verified FIXED. Supabase aulas.url_video values are now distinct per row. Only residual finding: aula 37's YouTube ID (iWvLO4B3Tq4) plays 'Video unavailable' — cosmetic data tweak, not a code issue.

rca of the issue.bug2: Previously, all 21 aulas had identical url_video in Supabase, so iframe src was the same regardless of aula id. Main agent patched the table with 21 distinct YouTube URLs via Supabase Management API. Aula.jsx already had correct reactive keys (key={embed} on iframe + key={`video-${id}`} on parent) plus useEffect state reset on id change, so once data was differentiated the iframe correctly remounts and shows the right video for each aula. Verified via direct URL navigation (3 aulas) and in-app click navigation (back + click).
